events.text: Morning Nori. Crunch month. I'm Tariq Al-Mansoor, CEO of RelayGrid here in Toronto (11-person B2B SaaS, dev workflow & CI/CD bottleneck analytics). Raising a $12M USD Series A ($48M-$52M pre) — Northstar Ventures (Claire Dupont) has us penciled for IC on Tue Jan 26, and MapleLeaf Capital (Graham Whitaker) is circling fast. Uploaded our 13-month metrics CSV. Three enterprise pilots in flight: Aegis Bank (180 seats), Boreal Logistics (120 seats), Veridian Health (150 seats). Biggest internal friction right now: my CTO Ben Sato wants $39/seat/mo Enterprise pricing to close pilots faster, I want $49/seat/mo so ACV clears $60k for IC. Read the CSV + my inbox and stay sharp.
